corrections: Replaced generic Harrier geometry with a dedicated radar-nose body, canopy aperture, D-shaped intake ducts and auxiliary doors, swept anhedral/incidence wing, LERX, single fin, stabilators, bicycle gear and four elbow nozzles.
Corrected length to47.75ft/14.5542m for the radar variant; fixed nose/main wheelbase3.481m and outrigger half-track2.591m.
Overlay iteration moved intake lips forward1m, added the wing chord slope, closed canopy shoulder joins and removed intake-wall penetration into the cockpit.

Rebuilt the twin-MPCD/UFC/ODU panel, central standby cluster, upper-right engine/nozzle display, offsetVVI, lower gear/flap and V/STOL controls, distinct side consoles, seat harness, center stick and separate throttle/nozzle levers.
Wired supported attitude,TAS,geometric altitude,true heading,VSI,normalizedRPM,nozzle angle,flaps,gear and controls. Corrected the RPM source path using actual kernel state in the test.
All four nozzle outlets rotate aft-to-down with the same0–90degree actuator value as the cockpit indication. Oriented flap/stabilator hinges are tested using world-space trailing-edge motion.

independentDimensions.panelScale: Estimated0.94mm per pixel of the documented crop; no manufacturing panel dimensions available.

reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected final-hash side/top/front/panel overlays, four turntable angles, three-quarter/operator/cabin/cabin-wide views and13 additional zero/cruise/limits/negative-altitude/missing/hover/transition/airplane/control/seat/console/detail renders. Compared exterior against Paul Maritz photograph and cockpit coaming/panel against released USMC cockpit-video thumbnail. Main planform and panel layout align; frontal drawing conflicts explicitly retained.
limitations: The Navy manual is an illustrative arrangement, not a manufacturing drawing. Its front view has a different implied height and relative body/wing placement from its side view. No nonuniform image warping was used; printed dimensions and the side/plan/photo evidence take precedence. Detailed frontal contour accuracy remains lower confidence.

Fuselage transverse sections, intake curvature, nozzle bend radius, wing incidence, canopy section, seat hardware and absolute cockpit dimensions are estimates; no station drawings or cockpit survey were found.

Nozzles cover the simulator-supported0–90degree range. Actual beyond-vertical travel, automatic flap scheduling, reaction-control plumbing, nozzle asymmetry and real engine thermodynamics are not simulated. Gear travel is a simplified translation/hide animation.

MPCD flight/heading pages are clearly marked SIM; no navigation/radar page or collimated HUD. TAS substitutes for unmodeled indicated airspeed, geometric altitude for pressure altitude, true for magnetic heading, and normalized engine RPM for actual engine-core RPM. Unsupported fuel,JPT,oil,AOA,radio and hydraulic values remain unavailable.

Console switch grouping, maintenance markings and selected fasteners are simplified; no full electrical system, canopy opening, speedbrake or weapons. Reference pixels remain local and are not distributed.
